messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — post-launch triage. I compiled the bugs + feature asks from Support and Beta last 48h. Need to decide what to push for the 2.7 patch vs backlog. TL;DR: 6 customer-facing bugs (2 critical), 4 small UX improvements, 2 medium features requested. Can folks chime in with cost/impact?

Raj (Support): +1. Customers: enterprise acct 'NimblePay' hit critical mem leak on long-running sessions, reproducible. They're paused on rollout. Also several docs-request tickets.

Ian (Eng): On the mem leak — I can prioritize a hotfix but it'll block 1 backend engineer for ~3 days. If we do that, it pushes the noncritical perf work out.

Sophia (Design): UX improvements are mostly copy + button placement. Small effort, can be a one-day task paired with QA.

Kevin (Runtime): Note: putting mem leak hotfix as canary only (dedicated infra) buys time. If we rollout wide, risk impacting other tenants. Ops bot can create canary.

Maya (PM): Proposed criteria for 2.7 patch: ship any customer-blocking bug (P0/P1), ship small UX fixes that reduce support volume (<2 engineer-days), deprioritize medium features. Thoughts?

Linh (Product): Agree. Also suggest we add a 'cost to rollback' check before shipping any behavioral change. For medium features, let's gate on metric improvement: >5% latency/cost reduction or >10% quality uplift in evals.

Ian (Eng): +1 to rollback cost gate. For the mem leak, I recommend: fix → internal canary → 24h metric observation → gradual rollout. I'll plan the PR.

Raj (Support): Can we surface a 'status' banner to affected customers for NimblePay? They'll want updates. I can draft language.

Maya (PM): Action items: Ian owns mem leak hotfix (ETA Wed), Sophia to scope UX changes (ETA Tue), Raj to draft customer comms, Kevin to spin up canary. Capture in roadmap: put medium features in "post-2.7" milestone. @OpsBot can you create channels/tasks?

OpsBot: Created task RD-1784 'mem leak hotfix' assigned to Ian. Created canary env 'nimblepay-canary'.

Kevin (Runtime): Quick heads-up — mem leak fix likely touches KV cache lifecycle. I can pair with Ian midday tomorrow.

Sophia (Design): I'll attach screenshots and copy suggestions to RD-1785.

Maya (PM): Thanks. One more: do we want to include the small UX fixes in the 2.7 release notes? Probably yes. @Olivia any QA bandwidth?

Olivia (QA): I have 2 test cycles free Tue/Wed. Can run regression on hotfix + UX. Will log test cases to RD tasks.

Linh (Product): Also propose we add a simple prioritization rubric to the thread for future: ['customer-blocking', 'security/regulatory', 'support-volume', 'engineering-cost', 'product-leverage'] and score 1-5.

Maya (PM): Good idea. Sample scoring snippet: 
```
score = customer_impact*5 + severity*4 - engineering_days*2
```
We'll refine but start using it.

Raj (Support): +1. Would help reduce back-and-forth.

Ian (Eng): FYI if we include the small UX fixes, timeline still holds. I'll estimate time Wednesday morning.

Maya (PM): Great. I'll update the roadmap and ping legal if any comms need review. Closing thread — thanks everyone. Let's reconvene after Ian posts PR.
